headline: Amsterdam airport customs officers seize twenty six rare turtles wrapped in duct tape
label: VIRAL
caption:
Wildlife traffickers tried to sneak endangered reptiles across the globe 🐢

According to the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority, customs officers seized twenty six rare Vallarta mud turtles from a checked bag at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport.

The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them from moving and were discovered inside a box with a toy car and a closed sock.

Officials stated the man was flying from Mexico to Hong Kong and the animals were presumably stolen from the wild. Conservation groups estimate that no more than 300 of these tiny freshwater turtles remain in the wild.
